supported_environment.os: Linux Ubuntu (see uname -a in setup evidence)

manual_preconditions: Host must have Docker and containerlab installed per README.md tool versions.
VM clock should be synced (NTP) before running - clock drift affected Suricata flow-timestamp evidence during Phase 4 and was resolved; see decision log / fault-recovery-log for details.
known_limitations: services/ contains minimal stub listeners (nc loops), not full application implementations - sufficient to prove firewall/routing behavior, not application-layer correctness.
Suricata flow-log flush timing observed at 9-13 seconds for a single SYN/RST exchange; tests use polling (up to 30s) rather than a fixed sleep to account for this.
